title: victoriametrics & vmagent: Make the config check optional
reason: Real new mkOption 'checkConfig' (bool, default true) added identically to both victoriametrics.nix and vmagent.nix. Only victoriametrics.nix has a real dedicated test (nixos/tests/victoriametrics/default.nix); vmagent.nix has no test file in nixos/tests, so only the victoriametrics side was targeted.
targets_toml: option_prefix=[services,victoriametrics], watch=[checkConfig]. (vmagent's identical option add was NOT targeted -- no test coverage exists for vmagent.)

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Real new option; head-side is TestConfigUnresolved (predicate exists, real option, but no test assignment sets it to a resolvable literal) rather than PredicateNotFound -- both are non-gap 'correctly declined to guess' classes, just distinct verdict labels for a related but not identical situation.

candidate_rendering_gap: raw.json summary is correct (changed:1, correct oba_verdict_transitions) but rendered summary.md shows all New findings/Resolved/etc = 0 with no notable entries -- specific to *_not_found <-> *_not_found style transitions where neither side has witnessed evidence.
